question: Which reformer gave the slogan 'One God, One Caste'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__option 4__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The slogan “One God, One Caste” is indeed attributed to Shree Narayana Guru (1855–1928), the prominent social reformer from Kerala.
 
 
• Shree Narayana Guru worked to eradicate caste discrimination and promote social equality in Kerala.
 
• His teachings emphasized:
 
• Spiritual unity: All humans are equal before God.
 
• Social reform: Breaking down caste barriers and promoting education and self-respect.
 
• This slogan became a symbol of his reform movement, inspiring efforts against untouchability and social segregation.
